description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Fyndhorn Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Fyndhorn Elder.
Repeat.
